text:
Type: solid pine two-door cabinet
Use: closed storage for linens, supplies or tableware, on the floor or the wall; living room, hallway, home office
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots and grain
Colors: light natural pine, warm honey knots
Shape: boxy square cabinet with two flat full-height doors meeting at a center seam, plain edges, simple and solid, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, natural, honest, calm
Goes with: white walls, linen, woven baskets, black accents; rustic, farmhouse or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: IVAR
product.description: Untreated solid wood is a durable natural material which is even more hardwearing and easy to look after if you oil or wax the surface.
